svg.title: Camera calibration card, 120 x 120 mm
svg.desc: Black fills: burn filled. Red lines: burn along the line. Blue: the plate's edge, do not burn. Fiducials 100.000 mm apart center to center; rulers 0 and 100 under their centers; lens grids 1 mm (31 x 21) and 2 mm (21 x 15), top right dot left out.
